question: Which **three** of the following statements about Azure resource tags are true? (Select three.)

options.text: A tag consists of a name and a value pair, such as env = production
Tags applied to a resource group are not automatically inherited by the resources inside it
Azure Policy can be used to require tags and even add or correct them automatically during deployment
Every Azure resource must have at least one tag before it can be created

explanation:
Tags are name/value metadata pairs (for example, **env = production** or **costCenter = 4021**) used to organize resources and slice cost and usage reports. Two mechanics are frequently tested: tags do **not** flow down automatically — tagging a resource group does not tag the resources inside it (though policy can copy tags down) — and **Azure Policy** is the enforcement mechanism, able to deny deployments missing a required tag or append/inherit tag values automatically.

**Why not the other option:**
- **"Every resource must have at least one tag"** — Tags are optional by default; resources deploy perfectly well without any. Tagging only becomes mandatory if your organization enforces it through Azure Policy.
